name: rowan
description: Hover over a variable to see the values rowan infers for it; accesses that can fail as diagnostics.

rowan.binaryPath.description: Path to the rowan binary. Empty: look for rowan/target/release/rowan under a workspace folder, under any ancestor of the analysed file, or next to the extension; then the binary bundled with the extension; then ~/.cargo/bin/rowan; then `rowan` on PATH.

rowan.valueDepth.description: How many levels of nested containers the hover's value shows before cutting them to […] / {…} / Name(…).

rowan.useServer.description: Keep one `rowan serve` process per workspace: results are reused while a file and the modules it imports are unchanged, and parsed modules are kept in memory.

rowan.analyseOnSave.description: Re-analyse a Python file whenever it is saved (and when it is opened).

rowan.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up on an analysis after this many seconds.
